profile.headline: Game Developer at MAXIMILLIAN
profile.summary: Software engineer, problem solver, builder. Full-stack web development breaking into game dev. Proficient with, SQL, C-based languages like Java and C#, and frameworks such as React, Spring Boot, and ASP.NET. Passionate about designing user-first systems that are scalable, secure, and easy to maintain.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Long Beach, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Developed RESTful Spring Boot microservices for user and device management, backed by MySQL.
- Built React.js dashboard for real-time device monitoring and customer controls.
- Automated CI/CD pipeline using Gradle and webhook triggers to deploy to AWS EC2.
- Integrated Stripe SDK for secure transactions and payment tracking.
- Collaborated with marketing and hardware teams to ensure brand and technical alignment.
Key Achievements:
- Implemented secure OAuth 2.0 authentication via Okta API (OIDC), reducing in-house maintenance and improving security compliance.
- Increased deployment reliability by automating infrastructure updates, reducing manual deployment time by 40%.
- Improved email deliverability for investor outreach, contributing to resolution of a funding bottleneck.

positions.title: Founder and Fullstack Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Founded and developed heroful.com, a gaming-focused social platform, learning full-stack development independently.
- Designed and built ASP.NET pages for login, feeds, and user profiles.
- Configured Microsoft SQL databases, designed schemas, and queried data via LINQ.
- Implemented user authentication and access control with Microsoft Identity.
- Developed real-time chat and notifications using SignalR.

Key Achievements:
- Modernized site responsiveness by replacing full page reloads with jQuery AJAX for smooth, dynamic updates, later refactoring the front end to React to meet evolving web standards.
- Migrated the platform from single-server hosting to Microsoft Azure, improving scalability and reliability.
- Integrated SendGrid and Twilio-based two-factor authentication, enhancing account security.
- Managed the full product lifecycle — from concept and design to deployment and scaling — gaining end-to-end development and entrepreneurial experience.

projects.title: Better Degree Planner
projects.description:
• Led the frontend of a team of 6 to create a React.js app improve the academic planning experience for students at CSULB.
• Parsed class info and prerequisites from webpage into JSON files and served to frontend via REST API endpoints.
• Documented User Stories and Software Requirements Specifications to capture project requirements.

projects.title: Dungeon Runners
projects.description:
• Created a plugin for a large Microsoft game title, facilitating a procedurally generated level system.
• Processed levels as 2-dimensional arrays of bytes, ensuring minimal memory and compute overhead.
• Collaborated in multinational Scrum meetings, using Kanban to prioritize tasks and deliver with limited time/resources.
